tax.text: Fong says his work in Congress is focused on lowering taxes and cutting regulations.
tax.quote: In Congress, I am working to lower taxes, eliminate crushing regulations, address the high cost of living

safety.text: Fong lists supporting law enforcement among his core congressional priorities.
safety.quote: In Congress, I am working to lower taxes, eliminate crushing regulations, address the high cost of living, support law enforcement

immigration.text: Fong campaigns on securing the border and ending illegal immigration through stricter enforcement.
immigration.quote: A secure border is fundamental to national sovereignty and public safety.

guns.text: Fong frames gun ownership as a constitutional right for law-abiding citizens and opposes new restrictions.
guns.quote: The Second Amendment is a constitutional right that safeguards the freedoms of law-abiding Americans.

abortion.text: Supported appropriations provisions prohibiting most federal funding for abortion.
abortion.quote: Preserving Hyde-like pro-life protections, prohibiting DOJ funds from being used for abortion except to save the life of the mother.

energy.text: Fong backs expanded domestic oil and gas production and energy independence to lower costs.
energy.quote: America should never have to rely on foreign adversaries to power our economy.

tax.text: Van Scotter supports requiring higher-income individuals and corporations to pay more taxes to provide relief for working families.
tax.quote: Yes, individuals and corporations earning above a defined threshold should pay more. Working families should not be underwriting corporate profits.

debt.text: She supports reducing waste and deficits but opposes spending cuts that harm elderly, retired, disabled, and other vulnerable people.
debt.quote: Reductions that harm children, disabled individuals, elderly and retired Americans while protecting tax advantages for the ultrawealthy are not fiscal responsibility — they are a transfer of suffering upward. Smart deficit reduction identifies waste without dismantling the programs that keep vulnerable Americans alive and dignified.

schools.text: She opposes eliminating the U.S. Department of Education and objects to public education funds flowing to private religious schools.
schools.quote: Federal education funding is the primary equalizer for under-resourced districts — 51% goes to the neediest third of schools. Eliminating it doesn't create local control; it creates chaos for the communities least able to absorb the loss. Returning funds to states without guardrails also risks public money flowing to private religious schools — eroding the separation of church and state in curriculum.

immigration.text: Van Scotter says she supports a pathway to legal status for undocumented workers, modeled on the Reagan-era amnesty.
immigration.quote: She supports a pathway to legal status for undocumented workers who have built their lives and livelihoods here, similar to the amnesty passed under the Reagan administration.

guns.text: She says current ownership restrictions are largely adequate but supports restricting military-style weapons and improving enforcement.
guns.quote: Military-style weapons have no place in hunting or civilian self-defense.

abortion.text: She says abortion decisions should be left to patients and physicians and supports legal access under any circumstances they consider appropriate.
abortion.quote: Under any circumstance that a patient and their physician determine is medically, emotionally, or personally appropriate. In 30 years as a medical professional, I observed that these decisions are never made lightly — they are made in pain, with care, and with profound personal weight. The government has no clinical standing in that room. The patient and doctor do.

gender.text: She rejects a blanket sex-at-birth rule for sports and shared spaces and calls for separate, evidence-based policies.
gender.quote: I strongly disagree. This prompt conflates unrelated issues — sports and shared spaces require separate, evidence-based policies.

health.text: She supports Medicare for All and describes health care as a right that should be guaranteed through public coverage.

energy.text: She backs the Green New Deal and a transition to solar and wind energy.
energy.quote: Solar and wind are the most reliable path forward

voting.text: She supports allowing people to vote without photo identification and says signature matching can preserve election security.
voting.quote: I strongly agree. California's system demonstrates that photo ID is unnecessary for secure elections. Voters are verified through signature matching — against DMV records or the Secretary of State — at the point of voting.
